# landscapeR

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of landscapeR is to provide some basic utilities to make developing the second ZERO2 landscape manuscript easier. 

## Installation

You can install the development version of landscapeR from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
if (!requireNamespace("pak", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pak")
}

pak::pak("selkamand/landscapeR")
```

## Quick Start

```{r quick-start}
library(landscapeR)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Basic theme for plots
iris |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Petal.Width, y = Petal.Length)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_landscape2()

# Basic colour schemes
palette_cancer_category() |> preview_palette()
palette_event() |> preview_palette()
```

## Requesting a change

Create a github issue with your request or a PR with the code already added.

## Saving plots

Ensure all plots are vector graphics and are exported to PDF format e.g. using `ggplot2::ggsave` or the helper `save_ggplot_as_pdf`. Please explicitly specify plot dimensions using `width` and `height` argument

```{r saving-plots, eval = FALSE}
# Create plot
gg <- iris |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Petal.Width, y = Petal.Length)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_landscape2()

# Print plot
gg

# Save as pdf
save_ggplot_as_pdf(
  gg,
  outdir = "figures",
  prefix = "iris",
  width = 2,
  height = 2,
  units = "in"
)
```
